notes: Bengaluru event-history priors for the 2026 forecast calendar. Factors multiply the normal same-weekday/time travel-time baseline; they are calibrated travel-time priors, not literal vehicle-count reductions. Strong Bengaluru-specific evidence is used where available. Low-evidence restricted holidays deliberately stay near 1.00 rather than inventing a citywide effect. Zone factors are additional multipliers for documented local hotspots.

genericLongWeekendEvidence.note: Bengaluru Traffic Police Joint Commissioner Karthik Reddy said long weekends can reduce inner-city congestion very sharply, with pre-holiday outbound traffic and Sunday-evening return surges.
